subject: Obsidian status: correlations reproduced, entity-sparsity caveat
body:
Hi Priya, Deshawn,

Status. Reproduction is done — we match the published WMT19 metrics-track system-level correlations from the released annotations across the 18 language pairs. Saoirse has the Evalline endpoint in staging as of Monday, slightly ahead of the Apr 17 date; scoring 10k segments takes ~40s on one VM.

The caveat we need to carry into the pilot: KoBE's signal comes from matched entity counts, so it degrades on entity-sparse text. On our internal conversational-support sample, 31% of segments have zero linked entities and the metric is essentially uninformative there. On entity-rich domains (news, product catalogs) segment coverage is 85%+ and correlations hold. Recommendation: pilot on the catalog localization pairs, and report KoBE alongside a fluency-oriented metric rather than alone.

Also, small thing — the annotation files use the release's per-system file layout, and Emeka's loader now handles all 262 systems without the manual renames we were doing in March.

Wei
